'''Ermi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]. Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were from Ermi, and were distinguished by crafting [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] with multifaceted [[Crystal/Legends|gems]] that caused stray energy tendrils to spiral off from their lightsaber blades. During the Clone Wars, distinct equipment inspired by the [[Ermi (species)|Jedi]] of the planet Ermi were available to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Ermi was mentioned in description of several items available in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] shop. It is possible that the planet Ermi is meant to be linked to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Ermi (species)|Ermi]], mentioned in ''[[Xim Week: The Despotica]]''.
